entities.summary: Professor George William Kyeyune is an artist and professor at the Makerere University, Kampala, Uganda. He lectures in sculpture and history of African art at the College of Engineering, Design, and Technology – Makerere University, with research interest in contemporary art and metal casting technology. He is also the vicar of the Namirembe Cathedral of the Church of Uganda.
